requirements.purpose: User specifies allowable clearance bounds, temperature interval and expansion coefficients.
requirements.description: User specifies allowable clearance bounds, temperature interval and expansion coefficients. The reference temperature is explicit. The program has no default clearance, material or operating range.

options.description: Each option identifies one permitted signed tolerance interval. Unchanged drawing tolerances stay at baseline. A shared drawing identity may control several independently manufactured occurrences.

compile.description: Combine repeated references to the same physical dimension before propagation. References to distinct manufactured occurrences can vary independently, even when they share a drawing.

algorithm.name: Compile signed chain
algorithm.description: Combine repeated references to the same physical dimension before propagation. References to distinct manufactured occurrences can vary independently, even when they share a drawing.
algorithm.method: Group by physical variable identity and sum signed coefficients. Preserve each distinct drawing identity for option assignment.
algorithm.validation: A dimension referenced as +1 and −1 contributes exactly zero.

outputs.name: Operating envelope
outputs.description: Global lower and upper clearance bounds and corresponding endpoint temperatures.

clearance-gate.purpose: Compare the full-range envelope with the required clearance interval.
clearance-gate.description: Compare the full-range envelope with the required clearance interval. Return both signed margins and limiting conditions.

outputs.name: Baseline bounds and margin
outputs.description: Feasibility comparison, both signed margins, and limiting endpoints.

outputs.name: Candidate feasibility
outputs.description: Candidate envelope and both signed margins from the shared evaluator.

algorithm.name: Clearance constraint
algorithm.description: Compare the full-range envelope with the required clearance interval. Return both signed margins and limiting conditions.
algorithm.formula: m_lower = g_min − g_required,min; m_upper = g_required,max − g_max
algorithm.edgeCases: Touching a limit passes with exact arithmetic on canonical inputs. A quantized CAD observation can still carry input uncertainty; exact arithmetic does not remove it.

options-expand.purpose: Form the Cartesian product of choices by drawing identity.
options-expand.description: Form the Cartesian product of choices by drawing identity. Apply each choice to every occurrence that shares the drawing.
